system.name: LADS
system.one_liner: Extend an image classifier to an unseen domain using only a language description of the shift, by learning an embedding-space augmentation in a joint vision-language space.

content.variant_note: three titled columns (what you have, the embedding-space shift, what you get); the middle one is a 2-D similarity plot with photo thumbnails
content.argues: Words describing the training and the unseen domain are enough to move training image embeddings into the unseen domain, giving a classifier an extended domain of both.
content.subject: Sunny road-sign photos, a wish to handle snowy ones, an augmentation moving a stop-sign embedding from the sunny to the snowy region, and the resulting mixed domain.

lessons.what_to_learn: Tell the story in three titled columns (what you have, what the method does, what you get) and keep one colour for the seen and one for the unseen domain through every column; in the middle, put photo thumbnails on two named similarity axes so an embedding shift reads as a move across a plane.
lessons.suits: Domain-adaptation, robustness or embedding-shift ideas that can be told with a few photos in two colour-coded domains.

evidence: leverages a multimodal model’s knowledge of the classes and the domain shift verbalized in natural language (“sunny” to “snowy”)
Then, real and augmented embeddings are used jointly to train a classiﬁer.

summary: LADS (Latent Augmentation using Domain descriptionS) extends an image classifier to a domain without images by describing the training and the unseen domain in words, such as sunny to snowy. In a joint image-and-text embedding space it learns an augmentation network that moves training image embeddings to the unseen domain while keeping the class, and a classifier is then trained on real and augmented embeddings. Figure 1 is a three-column teaser: a yellow tile of sunny road-sign photos with a stick figure's wish in a speech bubble; a 2-D sketch on sunny-snowy and stop-sign similarity axes where aug_θ carries a stop-sign thumbnail from a dashed gold box to a dashed blue box; and a 2 x 2 photo grid mixing sunny (yellow) and snowy (blue) signs.
summary_zh: LADS 只用语言描述训练域和未见域（如晴天到雪天），在图文联合嵌入空间里学一个增强网络，把训练域的图像嵌入移到未见域。图分三栏：左为晴天路标照片和简笔画人物的愿望气泡，中为相似度坐标里的嵌入平移，右为黄蓝两色混合的扩展域照片。
